title: A quadratic bound for Jacobsthal’s function

result.label: A quadratic bound for Jacobsthal’s function
result.statement: Answers Jacobsthal's quadratic-bound question: every interval of Ck^2 consecutive integers contains an integer coprime to any prescribed positive integer with at most k distinct prime divisors, for an absolute constant C . The bound is uniform over prime sets and interval positions and removes the classical logarithmic loss.
